svg.title: Figure 3a. Six kinds of misalignment, in musical notation
svg.desc: Six panels, each with the teacher's bar of music above the student's. Differences are in amber: a late start (rest), an extra note, a missing note, a note held too long, a note cut short, and an extra rest.
svg.text: Teacher's bar above, the student's attempt below. Differences in amber.
One constant shift anchors the first
the rest of the phrase still matches.
The same six cases as the system reads them are shown in Figure 3b.
